thread:
maya: kicking off the monthly incident-cluster synthesis thread — quick goal: surface top 3 cluster causes from last 90 days, confirm owners for remediation, and set timelines. sharing the draft clusters I pulled from the incident store.

liam: thanks — can you paste the query or a short list?

maya: pasted below. quick snapshot:
- cluster A: cache KV evictions causing 503 spikes (13 incidents)
- cluster B: model OOMs on dedicated pools during long prefixes (9 incidents)
- cluster C: auth token refresh race leading to 401 storms (6 incidents)
- misc: networking flakiness (tcp resets) - 5 incidents

alex: curious — cluster A looks like it correlates with the new 2s LRU policy we rolled out.

maya: yep — timestamps line up with the 2025-11-02 rollout. linked postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/PM-2323

ops-bot: Automated summary: analysis window 2025-01-01..2025-03-31; total incidents: 33; clusters identified: 4.

sophie: for cluster B (OOMs), is it all the same model or multiple models?

maya: mostly gpt-small-quant and a handful with gpt-medium-8k. pattern: long prefix + batch backpressure -> memory spike. see sample trace: `oom_trace_1789.log` (attached in the doc).

liam: I can own Cluster A remediation. proposed plan: revert LRU tweak on a canary pool (2 nodes), instrument eviction metrics, run load test for 72h. ETA 3 weeks.

dana: I'll take Cluster B. short-term: reduce max_seq for dedicated pools to avoid KV blowups; mid-term: work with runtime team to add per-request memory budgeting. ETA short-term 1 week, mid-term 6 weeks.

maya: thanks — for Cluster C (token race) we need platform + auth to sync. alex, can you coordinate with identity?

alex: yup. I'll open a JIRA and tag @identity to add stronger refresh locking. estimated fix: 2 weeks.

eng-oncall-bot: Note: Cluster A had 4 severity-2 incidents this window. Last SRE runbook updated: `cache-eviction-runbook.md` (version 2).

liam: action items (from me):
- A1: revert LRU tweak on canary (owner: liam) — due 2025-04-15
- A2: add eviction metrics to dashboard (owner: liam) — due 2025-04-22
- A3: load test 72h and report (owner: liam) — due 2025-04-25

dana: action items (from me):
- B1: temp guardrails reduce max_seq (owner: dana) — due 2025-04-10
- B2: proposal for per-request memory budgeting (owner: dana) — due 2025-05-20

alex: action items (from me + identity team):
- C1: jittered token refresh + lock (owner: alex + identity) — due 2025-04-18
- C2: audit for stale clients (owner: identity) — due 2025-05-05

sophie: can we add a recurring check to catch regressions? maybe a weekly alert if similar incident signature spikes > 3 in 7 days.

maya: agreed — ops-bot, can you create an alert rule draft for: `incident_signature_spike_v2` threshold 3 in 7d? tag it `incidents:cluster-monitoring`.

ops-bot: Created alert draft: `incident_signature_spike_v2`. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/incident_signature_spike_v2. Please review.

liam: ack, will review the alert rules after I push canary revert.

maya: small ask: when owners update their JIRA tickets, drop a link here with status and ETA. I'll pull everything into the quarterly ops report.

dana: noted — I'll link `RW-4442` after I land the guardrails.

alex: opened `RW-4399` for C1. tagged @identity and @security for review.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: please attach postmortem IDs to the remediation tickets to keep traceability.

maya: timeline summary for the channel:
- immediate (<=1w): B1 (dana)
- short (1-3w): A1 (liam), C1 (alex)
notes: monthly synthesis thread focused on incident clusters, ownership, timelines and alerting. concise action items included.
